versionGoal: Make the campus feel alive: situations that build up over several days, a reworked system for rules, clubs and buildings, and the groundwork for bigger story events.

now.title: Artwork for the lab story
now.summary: Finishing the images for the chain of events that starts in the Headmaster's lab.

now.title: Groundwork for bigger story events
now.summary: Groundwork for bigger story events: event flags, pausable situations and a new map system that makes room for places beyond the campus.

next.title: More situations on campus
next.summary: New ongoing developments that build up around the school over the days and come to a head.

next.title: Rules, clubs and buildings reworked
next.summary: Existing rules, clubs and building upgrades move to the new system, with visible progress and previews.

next.title: A few new events
next.summary: Some extra scenes around campus to fill out the days.

later.title: Potions you can use
later.summary: Brew something in the lab, take it to a location on campus and see what happens.

later.title: A school trip
later.summary: The whole school leaves campus for a few days. Things will be different when they come back.

later.title: New faces on campus
later.summary: New staff join the school, each with their own story.

later.title: A real science building
later.summary: The old lab building gets renovated, and with it comes a lot more to do.

done.title: Content preferences
done.summary: A menu where you decide which kinds of scenes you want to see.

done.title: School jobs, relationships and the cafeteria at the PTA
done.summary: School jobs, student relationships and reopening the cafeteria are back as proposals you campaign for and put to a PTA vote.

done.title: Older story chains back in the journal
done.summary: The sex ed plans, the late-night game in the dorm, Aona's trouble in P.E. and the new yoga outfits are back in the journal, with hints for every step.

done.title: Sounds for the interface
done.summary: The journal opens with a creak of leather, decisions are pencilled in, and a scribble on the map tells you something new is waiting in the journal.

done.title: Music
done.summary: Calm music on the map when a new part of the day begins, a quiet soundtrack under scenes, a theme on the title screen and its own volume slider.

done.title: More sound around campus
done.summary: Each place has its own background sound for the time of day, scenes keep it playing quietly, and ambience and effects have their own volume sliders.

done.title: No more raw labels in menus
done.summary: Event and place names load more reliably, and mod makers get a check that spots missing or broken names before players see them.

done.title: Hidden photos to collect
done.summary: Polaroids turn up around campus once something has happened there. Spot them, pick them up and keep them in the journal's new album.

done.title: A new look for the journal and the interface
done.summary: The journal is now a worn leather planner with ribbon bookmarks, and the title screen, dialogue box, menus and map display share its look.

done.title: Smaller save files
done.summary: Save files shrank, plus fixes for outfit numbers and missing images.
